message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has replied, but she's asking me if I've found a slot. It seems she missed my previous message where I told her none of the slots she proposed worked and asked for the full schedules for her partners.

I need to refer her back to my previous message. It's important to be clear and not accusatory. I will re-iterate my request for the full schedules.

My plan:
1.  Write a message to Alison in the workspace.
2.  The message will politely point out that none of the previous slots worked.
3.  I will repeat my request for the full busy schedules for Priya and Marcus so that I can find a common slot.
4.  End the session.

This should get us back on track. I'll be clear and direct to avoid any more confusion.It appears Alison may have missed my last message. I had informed her that none of the suggested times worked and requested the full schedules for her two partners. I'll respond now to get us back on track.

{"text":"Hi Alison, thanks for checking in. As I mentioned in my previous message, none of the initial slots you suggested work for Elena and David.

If you could send over the complete busy schedules for Priya and Marcus for next week, I can consolidate all four calendars and find a time that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Brad"}
